newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates - Prices thinly quoted on call.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates - Prices thinly quoted on call.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were lightly quoted Wednesday on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session. There were no trades, the same as Tuesday.
- Two barges, Mid-Mississippi River, next week, bid 110 percent of tariff, no comparison, no offer.
- Two barges, Illinois River, next week, bid 100 percent, no comparison, offer 110 percent.
- One barge, St. Paul-Savage, upper Mississippi, on station, bid 145 percent, no offer.
- One barge, St Paul, Mississippi, on station, bid 145 percent, no comparison, no offer.
- Five barges, Mid-Mississippi, one each week of June, bid 110 percent, no comparison, offer 120 percent.
- Five barges, Illinois River, one each week of June, no bid, offer 110 percent, no comparison.
